description: Find food additives in the Codex GSFA by INS number, name, or synonym. Returns each match with its INS number, name, synonyms, technological functional classes (thickener, preservative, colour, and so on), and how many food-category provisions it holds. Use to resolve an additive name or E-number to its GSFA entry before looking up permitted uses.

query.description: INS number, additive name, or synonym.
